claims: The Masters Green Jacket is awarded annually to the winner of the tournament at Augusta National Golf Club.
Only 1 (sometimes 2) Masters Green Jacket is awarded each year.
Winners hold the Masters Green Jacket for a year before returning it to Augusta National Golf Club.
Winners holding the Masters Green Jacket for a year before returning it to Augusta National Golf Club symbolizes lifetime honorary membership.
The Masters Green Jacket was introduced in 1937 to identify Augusta National Golf Club members.
The Masters Green Jacket is not for sale.
Augusta National Golf Club does not make Masters Green Jackets available to the public.
Only winners of the tournament at Augusta National Golf Club, Augusta National Golf Club members, and select individuals receive a Masters Green Jacket.
The winner can take the Masters Green Jacket home for the first year.
After the first year, the Masters Green Jacket must remain on Augusta National Golf Club's grounds.
The Masters Green Jacket is officially "Masters Green" (Pantone 342).
The Masters Green Jacket features a custom chest patch.
The Masters Green Jacket features brass buttons.
Masters Green Jackets cannot be worn at just any function.
Masters Green Jackets are generally restricted to official, respectful appearances.
If a winner's Masters Green Jacket is damaged, it can be repaired or replaced by the original, official tailor.
